other.general.title: Vague negative feedback about updates
other.general.description: Users leave generic complaints about the app and recent updates, often without naming a specific feature or problem.

billing.premium-paywall-features.title: Core features moved behind premium paywall
billing.premium-paywall-features.description: Customers say skipping, song choice, and lyrics were moved behind Premium, making the free experience feel downgraded.

usability.ads-interruptions.title: Frequent ads interrupt listening
usability.ads-interruptions.description: Listeners find ads too frequent and irrelevant, with several ads played between songs, making free listening frustrating.

usability.shuffle-playback-control.title: Skip and replay limits frustrate listeners
usability.shuffle-playback-control.description: Users say skip, rewind, repeat, and shuffle controls were limited or removed, often requiring premium, so they cannot choose what plays.

playback.general.title: Playback glitches and playlists failing
playback.general.description: Users report songs pausing, queues breaking, audio dropping, and playlists failing to load or save changes.

usability.interface-layout-changes.title: Removed download, queue, and sorting options
usability.interface-layout-changes.description: After an update, customers say familiar options like queueing, per-song downloads, and sorting disappeared, and they want them restored.

playback.playback-stops-crashes.title: Music stops playing or app crashes
playback.playback-stops-crashes.description: Songs stop automatically after one track or during use, and the app crashes, forcing users to reopen it and restart playback.

usability.general.title: Broad loss of basic features
usability.general.description: Users feel the update removed basic features like queueing, shuffle, loop, and full-song playback, leaving the app much worse.

access.general.title: Features fail to load or connect
access.general.description: Customers report artist albums and Wrapped not loading, plus connection errors despite working Wi-Fi, even after reinstalling the app.

billing.general.title: Frequent premium upsell prompts annoy users
billing.general.description: Users say the app constantly pushes Premium purchases and feels pressuring, and some say they would rather hear ads than pay.

billing.charges-cancellation.title: Payment failures and unexpected charges
billing.charges-cancellation.description: Users report failed premium purchases, payment method problems, and fees charged without warning, often needing support to resolve them.

catalog.songs-missing-removed.title: Songs and artists unavailable or disappearing
catalog.songs-missing-removed.description: Users find songs marked unavailable, liked tracks vanishing, and artists missing from search, especially in certain regions.

catalog.lyrics-missing.title: Lyrics fail to load or appear
catalog.lyrics-missing.description: Customers say lyrics never show or show a could-not-load error for many songs, and some note lyrics are often incorrect or absent.

billing.subscription-price.title: Premium subscription seen as too expensive
billing.subscription-price.description: Many users find Premium costly compared with other services and want cheaper pricing or a free ad-supported option in their region.

catalog.recommendations-autoplay.title: Autoplay drifts from chosen playlists
catalog.recommendations-autoplay.description: Users say autoplay switches away from chosen playlists to unwanted similar songs, and recommendations feel poor and mismatched to their taste.

catalog.general.title: Playlists and artist pages fail to load
catalog.general.description: Customers report liked songs, artist albums, and playlists not opening, along with automix playing only a limited set of songs.

access.phone-number-login.title: Phone number login errors block access
access.phone-number-login.description: Users cannot log in with phone numbers, seeing repeated error messages, and some can only log in on mobile data rather than Wi-Fi.

playback.offline-false-errors.title: False no-internet errors on connected devices
playback.offline-false-errors.description: The app shows no internet connection errors even when Wi-Fi or mobile data works, blocking search and playlist access.

access.password-social-login.title: Password and login credentials rejected
access.password-social-login.description: Users say correct passwords show as incorrect and login fails after resetting or reinstalling, with some getting persistent errors.

playback.buffering-slow-loading.title: Slow loading for playlists and search
playback.buffering-slow-loading.description: Customers say playlists, podcasts, and search take very long to load, making the app feel sluggish and glitchy.

access.app-wont-open.title: App fails to open or stops working
access.app-wont-open.description: Users say the app won't open or hangs, songs fail to load, and it stops connecting even after updates and reinstalling.

catalog.unwanted-songs-added.title: Unwanted songs added to playlists
catalog.unwanted-songs-added.description: Users find random artists and songs added to their playlists and liked songs that they did not choose, and want the additions removed.

access.account-session-signup.title: Random logouts and login failures
access.account-session-signup.description: Users are logged out unexpectedly, sometimes while offline, and cannot log back in even after clearing the cache on several devices.

playback.bluetooth-device-control.title: Playback closes or stops unexpectedly
playback.bluetooth-device-control.description: Customers say the app closes when used alongside other apps like maps, and songs stop playing, with the cause not tied to Wi-Fi.

downloads.downloads-deleted.title: Downloads disappear after logout or updates
downloads.downloads-deleted.description: Users say downloaded songs are removed after logout or without warning, and downloading a playlist unexpectedly adds songs to favorites.

downloads.offline-playback-needs-network.title: Downloaded music needs internet to play
downloads.offline-playback-needs-network.description: Users say downloaded songs and playlists will not play offline, making paid offline listening pointless when mobile data is off.

downloads.downloads-fail-to-save.title: Downloads fail to save on devices
downloads.downloads-fail-to-save.description: Users say songs will not download or stay saved, especially to SD cards on some phones, even after reinstalling the app.

downloads.general.title: Local files and podcasts won't play
downloads.general.description: Users report local files not playing on Android, downloaded podcasts failing after sleep timers, and songs missing from playlists.

catalog.content-bias-policy.title: Removed music sparks censorship complaints
catalog.content-bias-policy.description: Users object to removed music and artists, calling it censorship, and to unwanted political or news content appearing in their playlists.

support.support-response-quality.title: Support replies slow or unhelpful
support.support-response-quality.description: Customers say support emails get no response, troubleshooting does not fix problems, and agent advice has failed to work.

support.general.title: Vague dissatisfaction with support and value
support.general.description: Scattered remarks say support handled issues poorly and question whether the subscription is worth the money.

support.support-channels-broken.title: Phone support removed and hard to reach
support.support-channels-broken.description: Users say Spotify no longer offers phone support, and that in-app help and troubleshooting steps are unhelpful or hard to reach.
